properties.notes: This is a mill building which is currently occupied by a number of businesses. A planning permission was previously granted at the site for conversion. However the permission has now expired. There have been some pre-application interest from the owner/developer about bringing the site forward.. Full: Major: Conversion of mill building to 14 one and two bed flats on three floors with garages at ground floor and parking accessed off Kelbrook Road. Dwelling numbers taken from previous (lapsed) application.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
